title: capinfos: use the right terms for earliest and latest packets.
description:
One cannot reliably infer the start time and end time of a capture from
the packets in the capture, so, in the code and documentation, don't
refer to those times as the capture start and end times.

They also aren't guaranteed to be the time stamps of the ordinally first
and last packets in the capture; if the packets are not in chronological
order, the earliest packet may be after the ordinally first packet or
the latest packet may be before the ordinally last packet.  Label them
as the earliest and latest packets in the output.
